purpose: GitHub Pages generated public runtime endpoints for the MeIDs n8n agent runtime. Actor Twin embedded chat is the frontend entrypoint; Knowledge Fabric and Agentic Butler are normally called inside n8n as workflow tools.

actor_twin.probe_boundary: GitHub Pages runtime config generated from repository secrets.
actor_twin.next_action: Run Actor Twin UAT and capture n8n trace evidence.

knowledge_fabric_agent.probe_boundary: Knowledge Fabric Agent is expected to be called by Actor Twin inside n8n through a workflow tool. A direct public Pages URL is optional.
knowledge_fabric_agent.next_action: Verify the Actor Twin n8n workflow has the Knowledge Fabric workflow tool connected and published.

agentic_butler.probe_boundary: Agentic Butler is expected to be called by Actor Twin inside n8n through a workflow tool. A direct public Pages URL is optional.
agentic_butler.next_action: Verify the Actor Twin n8n workflow has the Agentic Butler workflow tool connected and published.
